long_biography.plain_text:
Motorcycle racing drew Joaquín Folch-Rusinol Corachan into competition before he switched to historic cars in 1987. He became known for preserving racing machinery, particularly Lotus and Ferrari models, and for driving it in competition. In a Brabham BT49, he twice won the Class C title in the historic Formula One championship.

Away from the circuits, Folch-Rusinol chaired Titan, the family's paint business, while professional managers handled its daily operations. His wider institutional work has included the presidency of Fundación Can Costa and trusteeship of Fundación Empresas IQS, which supports teaching, research and links between industry and education.
long_biography.html:
Motorcycle racing drew Joaquín Folch-Rusinol Corachan into competition before he switched to historic cars in 1987. He became known for preserving racing machinery, particularly Lotus and Ferrari models, and for driving it in competition. In a Brabham BT49, he twice won the Class C title in the historic Formula One championship.

Away from the circuits, Folch-Rusinol chaired Titan, the family's paint business, while professional managers handled its daily operations. His wider institutional work has included the presidency of Fundación Can Costa and trusteeship of Fundación Empresas IQS, which supports teaching, research and links between industry and education.
